# Fortex Appliance Repair

> Licensed (CA #50759) and insured appliance repair across Orange County, CA. Technicians come to the customer; there is no walk-in shop. Service visit is free with an approved repair, $80 otherwise. 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90 days on labor.

- Phone: (949) 478-0089
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–6pm · Sat 9am–4pm
- Book online: https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/book/
